patterns: APPSC asks single-figure recall from official MNRE data (e.g. cumulative solar 63.30 GW on 31 Dec 2022) - dated capacity figures are the main APPSC shape.
Classification traps recur across PSCs: nuclear not renewable, natural gas not green, geothermal/nuclear not from the Sun, non-conventional = renewable.
Other PSCs ask 'most eco-friendly / no pollution / greatest potential' - answer is almost always solar.
App adds many targets/programme items (GEC funding, RPO/RCO, IREDA) and 2026 rankings not yet seen in PYQs; these are sound but deeper than APPSC's direct-figure style.
